Diego (Accounting): We can issue a credit memo CM-7234 for $600 and link to next invoice INV-80045. Need finance approval and GL code.
Kara (Sales): Also tagging Product to update scheduler filters so Dedicated customers are excluded. Ticket EXP-SCHED-129 created.
Nina (Finance): Approved rollforward as goodwill credit. Use GL 5230-promo. Note: 'mistaken scheduled promo application sched-0426'.

Nina (Finance): Thanks team. Logging action in billing runbook and closing thread.
